title: cynoglossum hissaricum
intro: Cynoglossum hissaricum, commonly known as Hissar tongue flower or Blue tongue flower, is a plant species in the borage family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum hissaricum include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote the expulsion of mucus, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
